title: Implement poll() in file_operations (Option A)
description: Add .poll to crypto2dev file_operations. Readiness rules: POLLOUT|POLLWRNORM when fd is initialized and not finalized. POLLIN|POLLRDNORM when outbuf has unread bytes. Wake_up on outbuf write (in fd_write after update produces output) and on FINALIZE. Add wait_queue_head_t to fd state. Document in ioctl header.
close_reason: poll() implemented: wait_queue_head_t in fd_state, init in open(), EPOLLOUT when not finalized, EPOLLIN when outbuf has data, wake_up in fd_write and ioctl_reset, wired into file_operations, O_NONBLOCK limitation documented in ioctl header.
